[[File:Space_barge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A space barge]]
A '''space barge''' was an intra-[[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used to ferry cargo between [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable cargo ships, orbital facilities, and planetary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Space barges were short range vessels, usually not equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] but fitted with powerful [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and large cargo storage areas. Crews of space barges generally numbered three; a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], co-pilot, and [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]]. Barges were generally unarmed as they operated in urbanized systems with adequate defenses, and possessed limited [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].

The [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[X-23 StarWorker/Legends|X-23 StarWorker]] was an intra-system space barge.
